# Mushood Hanif — Portfolio & Technical Index

> Founder & AI Systems Architect | Senior AI Engineer specializing in multi-agent LLM orchestration, real-time streaming ML pipelines, physical policy verification, and high-throughput systems.

## Summary

Mushood Hanif is a Founder and AI Engineer with extensive experience leading production AI systems:
- **Haga Labs** (Founder & AI Systems Architect): Physical policy verification and benchmark layer for generative world models and robotics.
- **Afiniti** (Senior AI Engineer): LangGraph 6-agent document compliance pipeline (92% turnaround reduction), on-prem QLoRA fine-tuning, streaming fraud detection (<180ms p95 latency).
- **Confiz** (ML Engineer): Bilingual RAG support chatbot (40k+ monthly chats), FAISS vector retrieval, async FastAPI architecture.

## Key Technical Case Studies

- [Haga Physical Verification Layer](https://mushoodhanif.com/work/haga_case_study): Physics perturbation benchmarking and violation detection on MuJoCo/Robosuite.
- [Agentic Document Compliance](https://mushoodhanif.com/work/adcp_case_study): LangGraph 6-agent orchestration state machine cutting logistics review from 3 days to <4 hours.
- [On-Prem Fine-Tuning & Serving](https://mushoodhanif.com/work/oplftsf_case_study): Self-serve QLoRA LLaMA-3 fine-tuning and vLLM serving framework on single A100 GPU.
- [Real-Time Fraud Scoring](https://mushoodhanif.com/work/rtfsp_case_study): High-throughput streaming pipeline processing 1.2M+ daily transactions at <180ms p95 latency.
- [Bilingual RAG Chatbot](https://mushoodhanif.com/work/brsc_case_study): Urdu/English RAG chatbot with FAISS vector search handling 40,000+ monthly conversations.
